title: Opening a bakery without stalling the shop
target: How to add the bakery counter to a Supermarket Simulator shop without letting the rest of the shop stall while you learn how the counter works.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shop already selling from shelves
Money set aside for the counter and its fittings
Someone you can put on the bakery

steps.do: Fit the counter out before you start baking into it.
steps.because: the bakery display and its baskets are their own pieces with their own artwork (T_BakeryDlc_Display_BCA)

steps.do: Put a worker on it instead of baking and running the tills yourself.
steps.because: the bakery has its own kind of worker (BakerSO)

steps.do: Expect the goods to change as they bake rather than looking finished at once.
steps.because: the game ships separate surfaces for each baking stage (T_BakeryDlc_L1_Baked_BCA)

steps.do: Keep watching the rest of the shop while the bakery runs.
steps.because: the bakery runs through a manager of its own (BakeryManager)

steps.do: Check what is available before planning a range rather than assuming everything is.
steps.because: bakery content sits in the game's own list of added content (dlcProducts)

commonMistakes: Buying the counter and then leaving it empty.
Trying to run the bakery yourself while the tills queue.
Assuming every bakery item is available from the start.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
